name: Business Process Pattern Audit
problem: A business has fragmented operational events and wants to discover the real recurring workflow, cycle time and exception points without replacing its current systems first.
intent_terms: map how our process actually works
find bottlenecks in this business workflow
where are exceptions slowing us down
audit our procure to pay workflow
compare the real workflow to company policy
inputs: Tenant-scoped process observations/events and optional process/source-system scope.
outputs: Candidate step sequence, sample size, median duration, exception rate, confidence, evidence refs and review state. No policy change or external action.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Pattern discovery may analyze authorized data. Observed behavior is never silently promoted to configured policy.
invocation_status: SOURCE-VERIFIED: machine discovery docs, central MCP matching and authenticated Process Discovery are implemented and build-tested; external client canary remains pending.
